**Question.** Does the first real authenticated full-attention implementation leave enough K1 step time to exceed 451 aggregate token/s at c16?

| setup | |
| --- | --- |
| node | `gx10-5e36`, one GB10 |
| kernel | 6.17.0-1031-nvidia-64k, 64 KiB |
| Rocket code | `3df3bc4b38eedd63dacd73d60ed9c82e83770d32` |
| planner fix | `40a444df9d579a85813cf45e3b1dc6ea3b741752` |
| checkpoint | `nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4` at `fc694b54fb0174e0913e6adf86691ef85a4ead47` |
| rank slab | `a9fcca026a87ad1285b94feef19448c51b42d97516f16211c61ae4c770c6f0f4` |
| reference | vLLM `8e685d198`, Apache-2.0; FlashInfer `91bda04c`, Apache-2.0 |

```bash
cmake -S engines/qwen38-flash-next-nvfp4-2b \

cmake --build build-qwen38-attention -j2
```

The 8-warp BLOCK_N128 control preserved both hashes and raised score time to 8.10022 ms and layer time to 9.07182 ms. It was rejected and is absent from the selected source.

| state contract | value |
| --- | ---: |
| full-attention layers | 3, 7, ..., 47 |
| main state | 2,147,483,648 B/layer |
| raw state | 35,840 B/layer |
| compressed state | 268,435,456 B/layer |
| stage plus accepted-prefix publish | 28.099 us mean |
| reset replay | bit exact |
| output hash replay | bit exact |

The current slab stores the replicated index projection as two authenticated 320-row halves. Each rank reconstructs the BF16 `[640,2560]` matrix once. There is no hot-path exchange. Planner rule ordering caused this split; `40a444d` fixes future artifacts without relabeling the measured slab.

**Verdict.** Rejected for the >451 aggregate token/s target. The 3.332 ms K0 layer baseline consumes 62.221% of the K1 step budget across 12 layers. This run proves one-node rank-0 and rank-1 slab authentication, real QSA state traffic, accepted-prefix publication, and reset replay. It does not prove physical-peer execution, CUDA Graph replay, verifier widths above one, pinned full-intermediate parity, or full-model throughput.

**Next.**

- Replace the score grid with persistent gathered 16-key tiles and tensorized QK.
- Tensorize sparse QK/PV around one shared 12-by-16 probability tile.
- Prove physical rank-1 execution and pinned intermediate parity.
- Capture K1, K4, and K7 verifier widths with rejected speculative rows kept private.

**Reopen if.**

- A newer SM121 compiler or CUTLASS attention primitive changes the full-context score ceiling.
